objective: Make the real M09 adapter owner-testable from the Desktop Dashboard by running a disconnected Minecraft control service with an ephemeral launcher secret, exposing only fixed authenticated connect, disconnect, look.v1 and emergency-stop operations to operator-only typed Electron IPC.
non_goals: Do not expose the control token, adapter URL, Mineflayer objects or network access to the renderer or widget.
Do not add LLM planning, model-selected actions, generated code, eval, shell, arbitrary plugins or runtime skill registration.
Do not add movement, pathfinding, collection, crafting, storage, eating, fleeing, combat, chat, sign, book or destructive actions.
Do not auto-connect to a Minecraft server when Desktop starts.
Do not bind outside 127.0.0.1, persist the control token, reuse it after process restart or accept unauthenticated mutations.
Do not claim real-server compatibility, action success rate or emergency-stop server acknowledgement without an owner-provided resettable server.
contracts: Desktop launcher generates a fresh cryptographically random control token in memory, passes it only through child process environment, starts the adapter disconnected, and stops only the process it created.
Minecraft service binds exactly 127.0.0.1 and keeps health/status GET read-only; every mutation requires constant-time bearer-token verification plus X-Hina-Source owner.desktop.
Mutation bodies are bounded JSON with exact fields and ownerConfirmed=true; malformed, unauthenticated, oversized or unknown requests fail closed.
Connect targets keep the S1 localhost/private-IP and offline-auth restriction; Desktop does not auto-connect.
Disconnect cancels active skill work and permits a later reconnect; emergency stop cancels active skill work, clears controls, disconnects and remains latched until adapter process restart.
Only operator main-frame IPC can read Minecraft status or request connect, disconnect, look.v1 and emergency stop; the widget is rejected.
Renderer receives only normalized bounded status/result objects and never receives the token, adapter base URL, Mineflayer objects or vendor errors.
MinecraftPage is presentation and typed-intent only; App.vue owns polling and IPC orchestration, Electron main owns authority and network.
allowed_dependencies: Node.js, Electron, Vue and Mineflayer dependencies already pinned in the workspace; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Service tests prove authentication, exact schema, payload bounds, connect/disconnect/reconnect, verified look.v1, emergency latch and read-only unknown-route behavior.
Desktop client tests prove fixed numeric-loopback base URL, secret requirement, bounded response parsing and request validation before network I/O.
Electron security tests prove four Minecraft IPC paths are operator-only and the preload exposes only typed fixed operations.

Dashboard has a dedicated Vietnamese Minecraft page explaining when to use each control, showing connection/player/inventory/entity state and exposing only connect, disconnect, look and emergency-stop buttons.
start:desktop builds and launches the disconnected adapter service with an ephemeral token and cleans it up without persisting the token.
Minecraft tests, Desktop typecheck/build/tests, repository fast tests, module-brief validation, GitNexus scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M09-S3-desktop-owner-control-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
